cues: Green manure is a quick growing crop, usually a legume like dhaincha or sunn hemp, grown in the field and then ploughed back into the same soil while still green.
A good dhaincha crop adds sixty to ninety kilograms of nitrogen per hectare, plus organic matter that improves the soil's structure and water holding.
